premises.text: Enterprise design-to-manufacturing is cumbersome across heterogeneous machines, operators, file shares, and decentralized sites
premises.evidence_span: all day, they go back and forth with Excel files, spreadsheets, file shares. It's a very cumbersome process

premises.text: A cloud manufacturing platform connects 3D printers, CNC, water jets, robots, and assembly workflows for remote one-click production
premises.evidence_span: connecting all these machines and workflows in the cloud, anytime, anywhere

premises.text: Enterprises pay large per-site licenses to run the platform as they scale worldwide

value.text: Go from idea to real manufactured object instantly, anytime, anywhere
value.evidence_span: taking an idea to a real object instantly, anytime, anywhere

causal_links.evidence_span: time to market is one of the most important things when you're trying to beat your competition
looking to be more efficient as they scale worldwide

notes: Heterogeneous machine software and multi-site decentralization folded as one manufacturing-workflow pain (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Prior 3D-print OS traction and Ford/Cisco names treated as evidence/customers of the cloud platform and licensing, not separate premises; drone/CNC/robot/assembly/factory-duplicate demos folded as cascade of one cloud OS (§4.1.7). Anti-template: problem, platform, and licensing separately revisable.
